title: Cash Patronage Declared but Never Delivered, Carried Out With Equity Signed Over
content:
Cash patronage the cooperative declared but never delivered belongs to the transferor and is carried out with the equity under Membership and Patronage Equity, and how much of it moves turns on whether the member has already been reported as having received it.

The difference in question is the cash portions standing on the equity ledger's allocation notices less the cash delivered against them, rounded to two decimal places and never taken below nothing.

**Where the class's allocations are reported as qualified.** Where those cash portions are above the cash delivered and allocations on the membership are reported as qualified, the whole of the difference between them is carried into what moves.

**Where they are reported as nonqualified.** Where those cash portions are above the cash delivered and allocations on the membership are reported as nonqualified, the difference is carried in at the share the class's revolvement pool fixes, rounded to two decimal places.

**Otherwise.** Where the cash delivered stands at or above the cash portions declared, or allocations on the membership are reported as mixed, nothing is carried in.

## The readings on hypothetical figures

| Cash portions on the notices | Cash delivered | How allocations are reported | Carried in |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2400.00 | 1500.00 | qualified | 900.00 |
| 2400.00 | 1500.00 | nonqualified | 900.00 taken at the class's annual revolvement pool share |
| 2400.00 | 1500.00 | mixed | nothing |
| 1500.00 | 1500.00 | qualified | nothing |
| 1200.00 | 1500.00 | qualified | nothing |

**On the fourth and fifth lines.** Cash delivered standing at the cash portions declared, or above them, leaves no difference to carry, and the reporting of the allocations does not come into it.
